subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

C _ _ _ B _ _ A X B _ Z
solution:
Let's check all the options: 

__
 
• Option (1): XCZACA
 
• ​C X C Z B / A C A X B / A Z ​
 
• It is not logically following.
 
• **Option (2): ZAXCZC**
 
• **​C Z A X B / C Z A X B / C Z __**
 
• **It is logically repeating pattern. **
 
• Option (3): ACXZCZ
 
• ​C A C X B / Z C A X B / Z Z
 
• It is not logically following.
 
• Option (4): CCXAZA
 
• ​C C C X B / A Z A X B / A Z 
 
• It is not logically following.

​Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
